The trend shows a shift towards understanding the effects of temperature, environment, and microstructure on the degradation of these alloys. Earlier studies focused on developing high-entropy alloys with high strength and ductility, while recent studies have explored their corrosion resistance and wear behavior in various environments.

decision.why: The next step should involve a combined experimental and simulation approach to investigate the microstructure and corrosion behavior of multi-phase eutectic high-entropy alloys under simultaneous wear and corrosion at elevated temperatures. In-situ characterization techniques, such as X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and scanning electron microscopy, can provide valuable insights into the degradation mechanisms.
